contracts: SceneToggle and SceneCheckbox now derive from the common plain View RustActionView and construct no Button/ButtonController instances on their Rust production paths. Native comparison retains ToggleButton/Checkbox. Existing Rust ToggleState/CheckboxState still own checked values, toggle hover/progress and recipes.

Rust ActionControl owns pointer/key/gesture, enabled/focused/visual state and cancellation. A virtual activation adapter updates the Rust checked model before existing domain callbacks, including callback-free clear-data checkboxes. Checked state updates before ElementTracker notification, matching native checked controls; host-deletion protection remains before domain callbacks.

Checkbox default AX verbs derive from Rust checked state and retain check/uncheck across disabled/re-enabled transitions; disabled controls remove their action verb. Switch role/press semantics, checked metadata, text/native fonts/minimum geometry and no child Label/FocusRing policy remain.

Toggle and checkbox group scheduling synchronously retire clipped input before GPU pending coalescing. Native viewport/window/input/focus/AX adapters and existing preference/profile/import/controller/persistence policy remain.

The new shared case compares actual host types, AX checked/default verbs, observed checked state during ElementTracker activation, accessible activation, disabled admission and re-enable behavior. Rust-only branches verify hide and group-child clipping followed by late release and switch viewport scroll out/back. Existing physical Cocoa preference Space, import Space, capture/profile/menu/status cancellation and durable clear-data/import outcomes remain asserted through View adapters.
